items.q: Ahmad Jamal says a producer's job is just to go get coffee. But I hope he doesn't mind me quoting him because it's a hearsay. I didn't hear him say it

ctx.x: But you don't have the almighty producer, you know, directing, telling you what to do, 'cause …

[laughs] Now I know you're joking. [laughs] Ahmad Jamal says a producer's job is just to go get coffee. But I hope he doesn't mind me quoting him because it's a hearsay. I didn't hear him say it, so don't let that out, please. [laughs]
